Corporate NDT Technician Training Contracts — Built for Inspection Companies

Most corporate engagements fall into two buyer profiles. Asset owners (refineries, EPCs, fabrication yards) train their own maintenance and inspection staff for a specific turnaround or ongoing program. NDT inspection service companies run group NDT training for inspection company staff — building bench strength across a roster of technicians who get deployed to multiple clients, so cohort sizing, method mix, and certification cadence are structured as a standing training contract rather than a one-off course. A typical corporate NDT technician training contract specifies: cohort size (4-25 technicians per batch, scaled to bench strength), the method mix (UT, PAUT, TOFD, RT, MT, PT, ET, VT, MFL, AE, guided wave, thermography, each independently scoped by level), delivery mode (onsite at the inspection company's own facility, online for technicians already deployed across multiple sites, or blended), and a recertification cadence written into the contract term so Level II technicians renew on schedule instead of lapsing mid-assignment.

Methods covered: UT, PAUT, TOFD, RT, MT, PT, ET, VT, MFL, AE, guided wave, thermography. Levels I, II and III. Certification bodies: ASNT (CP-189 + SNT-TC-1A), ISO 9712, PCN, CSWIP, and API 510/570/653 for inspector pathways. Batch sizes from 4 to 25 technicians. Onsite delivery available in the US Gulf Coast, Middle East, India, UK North Sea, Norway, the Netherlands, Canada, Australia, Singapore, Malaysia and West Africa.

Full enterprise and multi-year framework packages available for asset owners (Aramco, ADNOC, Shell, BP, Chevron, ExxonMobil, QatarEnergy, KOC, PDO, ONGC, Reliance) and for EPC contractors and NDT inspection companies building out their own technician bench. Affordable, accessible, fully customizable — pricing varies by region, batch size and method count; request a tailored quote.

Pick a city for local delivery details, employers we already train, typical batch sizes, and city-specific FAQs: Houston, Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Mumbai, Hyderabad, Chennai, Aberdeen, Singapore, Muscat, Jubail, Calgary, London, Rotterdam, Perth.

About corporate NDT training

On-site cohort training run at your facility, on your equipment and specimens, against your written practice. It qualifies a whole crew consistently, produces a personnel record that survives a client audit, and avoids the travel cost and scheduling drag of sending technicians to public courses one at a time.

Where to go next

If you are qualifying people, start with NDT training and certification and the ASNT certification pathways. If you are building or defending a programme, start with ASNT Level III consulting. If the problem is that the records exist but cannot be produced on demand, that is what inspection management software and the asset integrity platform are for. Ask a Level III directly.
